entries.en: Activate the defenses! Seal the station!
The arms aren't moving! Systems not responding!
Abandon the Citadel! Evacuate the Council!
Open the mass relays. The fleet needs reinforcements!
The relays are locked! Someone's taken over all the systems!
Citadel control! Citadel control! Do you copy?
We're getting hammered out here! Why won't you respond? Citadel control? Citadel control!
This city is too quiet.
I wonder how many lived here?
Feel like I'm walking over a grave.
I wouldn't touch anything.
Feels like we're being watched. And not by the geth.
Let's just find the Conduit and get the hell off this world.
I wish I had more time to study all of this.
So much history here. So much to learn. I only hope I have the chance to come back some day.
This place feels wrong to me. And not just because of the geth.
There are secrets here that were meant to be forgotten.
There's something in the air here; death is on the wind. It's a good place for killing.
A lot of people died here long ago. Now it's time for a lot of geth to join them.
My people once tried to find this world. We hoped we could settle here. But we didn't know it would feel so... unwelcome.
We shouldn't be here. Not us. Not the geth. Not Saren.
This must be the command center for the entire complex. Saren's troops must have sealed the doors from here after he went inside.
We will have to figure out how to disengage the security lockdown if we ever want to get inside that bunker.
I bet this is the command center for the entire complex. Saren's troops must have sealed the doors from here after he went inside.
We'll have to figure out how to disengage the security lockdown if we ever want to get inside that bunker.
This place still has power. It must be running off its own generator.
Those armatures out there look like they're up and running again.
When we disengaged the lockdown, the automated defense system must have kicked in and reactivated them.
This might work to our advantage. If the Prothean defense systems are controlling them, the armatures might actually see the geth as invaders.
This might work to our advantage. If the Prothean defense programs are controlling them, the armatures might actually see the geth as invaders.
Come. Saren already has a headstart. We have to go find him before he reaches the Conduit.
Come on. Saren's already got a headstart. We have to go find him before he reaches the Conduit.
Unless he's already found it. Then we're just walking into a trap.
That is a chance we will have to take.
That's a chance we'll have to take.
What is this? Some kind of defense bunker?
Probably. The Protheans could have used this elevator to deploy reinforcements to protect the rest of the complex.
What do you think the geth are doing with those armatures?
It appears they hooked them into the Prothean maintenance bays to make repairs. The security lockdown must have deactivated them.
Looks like they hooked them into the Prothean maintenance bays to make repairs. The security lockdown must have deactivated them.
I just hope they don't suddenly become active again.
That thing wasn't flashing before. What's going on?
It must have activated when we disengaged the security lockdown. Looks like some kind of operations pod.
The Protheans probably used it to control the automated defenses.
It's a massacre out there! The armatures are wiping out the geth!
They are being controlled by the station's automated defense programs. They are attacking anything that is not Prothean. If we go out there, they will attack us, too.
They're being controlled by the station's automated defense programs. They're attacking anything that isn't Prothean. If we go out there they'll attack us too.
Hold on... something's happening.
Sounds like some kind of message. But I don't recognize the language.
... [static] --ot safe-- [static] ... seek refuge... [static] --side the archives... [static]...
It is probably in Prothean. This recording must be 50,000 years old. No wonder we cannot understand it.
It's probably in Prothean. This recording must be 50,000 years old. No wonder we can't understand it.
--alled Reapers. [static]... the Citadel... [static] ...overwhelmed... [static] ...only hope... [static]...
What's it saying? Can you make out anything useful?
--[static] act of desperation... [static] ... the Conduit... [static] ... all is lost [static]
...cannot be stopped... [static] ...cannot be stopped... [static]
--too late. [static]... unable to... [static] ...invading fleets... [static] ... no escape... [static]...
Of course. Between the beacons and the Cipher, an understanding of the Prothean language would have been transferred into your mind.
Incredible! The Cipher must have transferred an understanding of the Prothean language into your mind.
The message is all broken up, but I recognize some of the words. It's a warning against the Reaper invasion.
